head: codex/5829-capability-envelope
title: [v0.92][WP-12][runtime] Implement the canonical capability envelope
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5829

## Summary
- adds a versioned deterministic Runtime v3 capability envelope bound to accepted WP-08 birthday evidence and digest-valid WP-09 identity evidence
- separates untrusted requests from provisioned provider/model/tool/skill policy and enforces explicit grants, denials, resource limits, provenance, and unsupported claims
- fails closed on stale or unknown evidence, escalation, omissions, collisions, secret-like content, private paths, host paths, and reconstructed packet forgery
- adds an issue-specific native macOS/Linux receipt workflow with exact inventory, provenance, artifact isolation, semantic-equivalence validation, and sanitized retained logs

## Validation
- focused capability-envelope nextest: 13/13 passed
- strict Clippy, formatting, Ruby syntax, workflow YAML, and diff hygiene: passed
- WP-08/#5825 and WP-09/#5826 verified closed and ancestral
- retained #4761 capability-envelope evidence independently validates at exact revision e93b36cc996429783f68ac4bed5365fb30fe3e07
- the native log normalizer and validator path-hygiene synthetic regressions pass; replacement exact-head macOS/Linux execution remains mandatory before merge

## Review
- exact assigned review by /root/sprint4_5857/review_5829_exact_head: APPROVED, no findings
- reviewed revision git-blake3:b5219330eaba31730a2f2ba2a6e2d5deb9242b64:765c113755a0d5a971adf5a147d092c2b613540fbb45df47abfcf597514f3694

## Non-claims
- does not execute providers, configure credentials, grant authority, complete witnesses, or approve downstream Birthday work
